title: Accurate Hover Detection in Design App Scene
description: Fix inaccurate hover detection in the sketchpad design app scene window. Goal: extremely accurate hover for dense 3D scenes with many meshes, giving clear instant feedback and always selecting the correct visible front object even when shapes overlap in depth.
summary:
Fixed inaccurate hover detection in design app scene with two changes:

1. Disabled raycasting on non-mesh objects (Line/LineSegments/Points) in GLTFMesh, FBXMesh, OBJMesh. These had a default raycast threshold of 1 world unit, causing lines to capture hover intersections intended for mesh surfaces of other pieces — the primary cause of inaccurate hover in dense scenes.

2. Centralized hover via onPointerMove on ModelDesign group instead of per-piece onPointerEnter/onPointerLeave. The centralized handler iterates event.intersections (sorted by distance) and resolves the first intersection piece GUID, guaranteeing the front-most visible piece is always hovered. Removed per-piece hover state management from ModelPiece to eliminate race conditions between enter/leave events on overlapping objects.
